rootCause.verdict: TEST INSTRUMENTATION DEFECT. Not product code, not the TRACE load, not worker capacity, not a misaddressed stop.
rootCause.mechanism: The guided runner worker is one long-lived Node process for the whole class. Its test preload (GuidedPublicationReplayIT.p4RevocationScalarSupport, a Java text block) keeps a module-level counter revC6HighPending of in-flight high-level fillPassword calls. Kind 3 (actualGuidedOwnedPrimaryBrowserLossWhileNativePasswordWorldPending, Order 31) kills the browser while one fill is pending. By design that count stays 1 and is published as kind 3's own evidence (sample highPending=1, nativeActive=1). revInit reset revC6HighPending only for c6 kinds 1-3. Kind 4 never wraps fillPassword (its beforeSecretFill hook throws first), so it inherited the stale 1. Kind 4's stop-time restoration drain waits for runtime.busy || revC6CdpPending || revActive.size || revC6HighPending to clear. It waited the full 10 s, then called revFail() and never emitted event 6 (descriptor restored). Java then failed 'exact descriptors restored after original dispatch lifetime' (p8AwaitC6Closed:9493 via p3CleanupOwnedResources:7829) and the producer seal sample never arrived ('actual producer final ACK/failure processing sample', :8569).
